summary: Feed s184_triple to IDS is degraded: 6.6% jumbo frames dropped at 1518B NIC, 3.0% TCP packet loss, and 10.2% duplicates. IDS needs both directions and full payload, so oversize and loss cause blind spots for signature matching and stream reassembly.

findings.root_cause: Network forwards jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes while the IDS 1Gbps capture port is limited to 1518 bytes and does not support jumbo. 218 of 3309 frames (6.6%) exceed the tool MTU and are silently dropped by the NIC.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to 6.6% of traffic. Because this IDS needs full payload for signature and exploit detection, dropped jumbo frames cannot be recovered by slicing; attacks hidden in large frames, file transfers and lateral movement will be missed.

recommended_fix.why: Trimming/slicing is not an option for this IDS (needs full payload). Must either enable jumbo (~9000B) end-to-end to the tool or enforce 1518B MTU upstream so frames are not dropped at ingress.

findings.root_cause: Packet loss before the tool - likely SPAN/mirror drops or packet broker buffer oversubscription. TCP sequence gaps detected in 95 of 3148 TCP packets (3.0%) exceeding 1% threshold, indicating random drops in the visibility path.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot reliably reassemble TCP streams; 3% missing data causes incomplete flows, missed exploit payloads split across segments, and false negatives for C2/exfiltration detection.

recommended_fix.why: SPAN drops packets under load and broker buffers overflow. Passive TAP plus lossless broker delivery eliminates pre-tool gaps and restores complete TCP streams for IDS analysis.

findings.root_cause: Broker is aggregating multiple TAP/SPAN feeds covering same traffic without deduplication, or a SPAN configuration mirrors same packet twice. 339 of 3309 packets (10.2%) are duplicates, double the 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes cycles inspecting same packet twice, inflates flow/alert counts, confuses TCP reassembly and thresholds, and can mask true anomalies while reducing effective inspection capacity.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker deduplication to forward only one copy of each packet so IDS sees accurate traffic volume and correct state tracking.
